name: NordVPN
tagline: The most popular VPN — audited no-logs policy, Panama jurisdiction
highlights: Independent no-logs audit completed by PricewaterhouseCoopers (2022)
Panama jurisdiction: outside 14 Eyes, no mandatory data retention
10 simultaneous device connections included on all plans
verdict: The best all-rounder: audited no-logs policy, fast speeds, and strong streaming support.
bestFor: Most users who want a reliable, audited VPN with good streaming support

name: ExpressVPN
tagline: Fastest speeds with Lightway protocol — owned by Kape Technologies
highlights: Lightway protocol delivers consistently the fastest speeds in independent tests
British Virgin Islands jurisdiction: outside 14 Eyes
verdict: Fastest VPN available, but significantly more expensive and owned by Kape Technologies (formerly Crossrider).
bestFor: Users who prioritise raw speed and are willing to pay a premium

name: Surfshark
tagline: Unlimited devices, best value — Netherlands jurisdiction
highlights: Unlimited simultaneous connections — share one subscription with your household
Independent no-logs audit completed by Deloitte (2023)
CleanWeb feature blocks ads and trackers at the VPN level
verdict: Best value for families or households — unlimited devices at a low price, though Netherlands is in 9 Eyes.
bestFor: Families or users who need to cover many devices on a budget

name: Mullvad
tagline: Maximum anonymity — accepts cash and Monero, no email required
highlights: No email, no account name — sign up with just a generated account number
Accepts cash and Monero payments for complete anonymity
Open source client; independently audited by Cure53 (2022)
verdict: The gold standard for privacy — no affiliate programme, and we recommend it anyway.
bestFor: Privacy-focused users who want maximum anonymity and don't need streaming

name: ProtonVPN
tagline: Swiss-based, open source, free tier available — from the makers of ProtonMail
highlights: Switzerland jurisdiction: strong privacy laws, outside 5/9/14 Eyes intelligence alliances
Fully open source clients audited by SEC Consult (2022)
Free tier available with no data limit — the only trustworthy free VPN
verdict: Best for privacy without sacrificing usability — Swiss jurisdiction and open source code are hard to beat.
bestFor: Privacy-focused users who also want open source, audited software
